asks: Is this the right room? I was told there would be a mark on the door.
How long have you been here, all told, not tonight?
Did somebody send you as well?
description: A figure in a long dust-coloured coat stands here, boots worn through at the side, carrying a bundle done up with string. Everything about them says they have walked here from somewhere that took months.
emotes: {it} sets the bundle down, considers it, and picks it up again.
{it} knocks the dust off one sleeve, and the dust hangs in the air far too long.
{it} looks at the door as though timing something.
looks: The dust is in the creases of their face and in the weave of the coat and it isn't city dust.
The bundle is tied with a knot you have never seen and wouldn't be able to undo.
They're looking at you as though they expected you and are checking you against a description.
name: a pilgrim covered in road dust
says: I have come a long way to be in this room.
You're the third today. It isn't a large number.
Nothing is required of you. I would say if it were.
